comment: Hand-maintained navigation routes. Each route names the projects whose declarations its selectors are matched against (substring match on the Roslyn documentation id). Selectors that match nothing fail index generation. constantRoutes turns uses of a constants class (and listed string aliases in case labels) into generated 'format:<name>' routes.
